description: This file defines data models for weather conditions and forecasts, including classes for current conditions, hourly forecast, and daily forecast.

classes.name: CurrentConditions
classes.description: Data model representing the current weather conditions for a specified city, including temperature, condition, icon, and temperature range.

classes.name: HourlyForecast
classes.description: Data model representing the weather forecast for a specific hour, including temperature and icon.

classes.name: DailyForecast
classes.description: Data model representing the weather forecast for a day, including high/low temperatures and icon.
